home.intro: The curriculum builds from cell references through Apps Script and large-scale debugging. Each lesson provisions a fresh Google Sheet in your Drive. When you finish, the app reads the sheet back and tells you exactly what worked and what didn't.

content.title: Content management
content.description: Edit lesson prose in either language. Edits save as drafts; publishing to git is a separate step.
content.warningBody: MDX tags like <MiniGrid> and <RefDemo> are interactive components. Changing their tags or props will break the lesson. Edit the text around them.
content.missingFile: No file exists for this language. Create it in the repo first.
content.publishSuccess: Published. Live in about a minute once Vercel rebuilds.
content.publishDisabled: Save your draft first to enable publishing.
content.publishUnavailableNoToken: Publishing is offline: the server has no GitHub token configured. Ask an admin to set GITHUB_PAT.
content.publishUnavailableRemoteMissing: Publishing is unavailable: this file does not exist on the main branch. Create it via git first.
content.publishUnavailableGithubError: Publishing is offline: cannot reach GitHub right now. Try again in a minute.
content.noDraftToPublish: There is no saved draft to publish.
content.conflictHeading: Someone else published since you opened this page.
content.conflictBody: Your draft is safe. Reload to pull in the new base, then re-apply your edits and try again.
content.previewSaveFirst: Save your draft first; preview renders the saved version.

preview.bannerBody: {track}/{slug} ({lang}). Not live yet. Publish from the editor to ship this version.
preview.noDraft: There is no draft to preview for this lesson.
